description: This file contains C source code implementing functions for processing and deserializing WebConfig structures related to WAN interface configurations, including handling msgpack objects for WAN marking, interface parameters, and failover settings.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WaneMgr_WebConfig_Process_MarkingEntry(WebConfig_Wan_Marking_Table_t * e,msgpack_object_map * map)
methods.description: Converts a msgpack map into a WebConfig_Wan_Marking_Table_t structure by parsing fields such as Alias and EthernetPriorityMark.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanMgr_WebConfig_Process_ifParams(WebConfig_Wan_Interface_Table_t * e,msgpack_object_map * map)
methods.description: Parses a msgpack map to populate a WebConfig_Wan_Interface_Table_t structure, including handling of marking tables.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanMgr_WebConfig_Process_WanFailOver_Params(msgpack_object obj,WanMgr_WebConfig_t * pWebConfig)
methods.description: Processes a msgpack object to populate WAN failover parameters in the WebConfig structure.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanMgr_WebConfig_Process_Wanmanager_Params(msgpack_object obj,WanMgr_WebConfig_t * pWebConfig)
methods.description: Deserializes wan manager parameters from a msgpack object into the WebConfig structure, including interface tables.
